stem.en: Which one of these statements is true?

text.en: Work is done whenever a force is applied, even if nothing moves.
A stretched rubber band held still has kinetic energy.
Lifting a bucket straight up does positive work on it.
Energy cannot change from one form to another.

explanation.en: Lifting a bucket: the force is up and the bucket moves up, so the work is positive. Work needs a displacement, so a force alone does no work. A band held still is not moving, so it has no kinetic energy; it has potential energy. Energy can change from one form to another.

hints.en: Work needs a force and a displacement.
Which kind of energy does a still, stretched band have?
